chunks.title: Purpose
chunks.heading: Purpose
chunks.text: This document defines the FPPO Goods Movement Automation between the multiple GSTIN of same company, based on the approved process flow.

chunks.title: Business Requirement
chunks.heading: Business Requirement
chunks.text:
The automation covers the end-to-end flow starting from Sales Order creation at one Unit through dispatch, invoicing, receipt at another Unit, and reverse invoicing back to the first Unit.
The remaining processes not linked to material movement will continue to be handled manually.

chunks.title: Scope
chunks.heading: Scope
chunks.text:
The Scope of these specs is to facilitate :
• Automation of inter-unit goods movement transactions

chunks.title: Section 2. Assumptions
chunks.heading: Section 2. Assumptions
chunks.text:
• Sales Order : User created Sales Order at Bangalore Unit.
• Sourcing and Material Requisition
• System shall generate material requisition based on Sales Order.
• Approval workflow: PD → FPPO
• FPO : will be created in the Bangalore Division
• FPPO : will be created in the Andhra Pradesh Unit
• Destination/Input site(Andhra Pradesh site) and Available quantity site(Bangalore Site) are related to different Divisions

• The user shall be able to view the populated Stock Site value as per standard dropdown behavior.

chunks.title: Changes Required :-
chunks.heading: Changes Required :-
chunks.text:
We need a setting in order to auto trigger a chain of event which is currently done manually :-
• Setting Name : “Direct issuance to FPPO from different GSTIN”
• Chain-of-events when the above setting is enabled :-
• As soon as the user create a FPPO dispatch instruction(GDI) in the Andhra Pradesh Division against the above FPPO
• System will auto create GDI-Transfer-to -site for the available quantity from source site to the destination site (i.e from the Bangalore site to the Andhra Pradesh site).
• User will manually create a Good dispatch note for the above GDI
• Upon above GDN confirmation, system will auto create a GRN-Transfer-from-site in Andhra Pradesh.
• User will manually confirm the above saved GRN to complete the chain of events
• Upon above confirmation system will auto create Production Process Order Input GDI/GDN from Transfer from Site GRN
• The above transfer to site GDN/GRN will be available for E way bill creation Bangalore to Andhra Pradesh.
